categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Touches only doc/i2p.md and bears the Docs maintainer label.
categories.rationale: Corrects inaccurate documentation that claimed any SAM v3.1 router works when older versions actually fail. Following PR #35696, Bitcoin Core requires `i2cp.leaseSetEncType=6,4`, making Java I2P >= 2.10.0 and i2pd >= 2.58.0 necessary to avoid configuration failures.
